---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or an improvement to an existing one
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What's the problem this solves?**
Describe the gap or pain point — not the solution yet.

**Proposed approach**
How you'd implement it, at whatever level of detail you have. If it touches
detection, alerting, or multi-tenancy boundaries, please say so explicitly —
those get extra review (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Would this be real, end-to-end, or partial?**
This project's convention is that nothing ships half-wired without an
honest "not implemented yet" label — see CONTRIBUTING.md. If your proposal
can only be done partially for now, say what the honest partial version
looks like.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about and why you didn't go with it.
